group_ledger.method: Reuse all 41 original semantic BWP groups with full source records, then add target continuation/qualification fields. No keyword projection or numerical partition. Overlap is intentional.

resolution_rules: An evidence/bwp-corpus/BASENAME locator names that exact BASENAME archive member of the immutable bwp_packet; the retained pointer selects its complete record. Archive-member byte/hash pins are retained above.
An evidence/original/*_PROPERTY_LEDGER.json locator names the corresponding exact original_lineage_ledgers route; preserve its supplied pointer and canonical record hash.

Within-lineage *_COMPOSITION_MODEL.json locators remain historical source routes in the same lineage corpus and frozen lineage packet. Their relation identities remain in full; this reconstruction does not claim a new whole-archive reacquisition or execution.
evidence/target/DISPOSITIONS.json and EXPLICIT_BRIDGE_DISPOSITIONS.json resolve through the separately pinned corrected historical target routes, never through current receiving judgments.

historical-private-run/ aliases preserve the exact semantic suffix and line range of the supplied private-run locator. They are provenance locators, not a claim of public access or present runtime ownership.

evidence/qualification/JOIN.json is a historical aggregate pointer. The complete supplied per-occurrence qualification meaning is accessible in qualification_contexts; its linked private documents retain their individual availability limits.

canonical_hash_rule: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma,colon), no final newline.

preservation_contract.property_rule: Keep every primary property field and value after the declared private-root normalization. preservation_contract.group_rule: Keep every primary group field and value after private-root normalization. Replace only the duplicated original group dump with its exact public binding and the material_relations record list with the reversible ordered ID encoding.
preservation_contract.qualification_rule: Dictionary keys hash the complete ORIGINAL context before privacy normalization. public_projection_sha256 hashes the complete accessible normalized content. preservation_contract.material_relation_rule: For each ordered record_id BWP-Rnnnnn, reconstruct exactly {id: record_id, pointer: '/relations/' + decimal(int(nnnnn) - 1)}. Path and count are unchanged; no sorting or deduplication is permitted.
preservation_contract.privacy_rule: Replace only the recognized absolute private Windows run root with historical-private-run/ and normalize path separators in those locator-bearing strings. Preserve directory/basename suffixes, IDs, byte/hash pins, JSON pointers, line ranges and every nonlocator semantic statement. No semantic content is replaced with a hash.
preservation_contract.identity_annotation_rule: Additional __published_identity_* sibling fields are presentation metadata. They qualify historical or published unallocated references and create no allocation. Original semantic values and array order are unchanged.
preservation_contract.author_verification_scope: This builder checks every property/group reconstruction, public binding, context occurrence, relation pointer and immutable input. reason.source: Retain uncertainty-aware support as an assumption-sensitive import, not a universal reliability wrapper. The sepsis study reuses one modest static dataset and disclaims deployment readiness. Conformal marginal coverage does not require accurate base probabilities, and it does not establish per-case conditional safety under arbitrary drift.
reason.target: Calibration, set coverage and abstention are not existing IMPLEMENTAUDIT evidence fields; they are needed for consequential predictive outputs.
reason.qualification_limit: Only if prediction output is in scope.
